content: मराल {%a.%} [मृ-आलच्] .²1 Soft, greasy, unctuous. .²2 Bland, tender. .{@-लः@} .({@-ली@} {%f.%}) A swan, flamingo, goose; मरालकुलनायकः कथय रे कथं वर्तताम् <ls>Bv. 1. 3</ls>; विधेहि मरालविकारम् <ls>Gīt. 11</ls>; <ls>N. 6. 72</ls>. .²2 A kind of duck (कारण्डव). .²3 A horse. .²4 A cloud. .²5 Collyrium. .²6 A grove of pomegranate trees. .²7 A rogue, cheat. .²8 A particular mode of joining the hands.
